title: ONSure Official Learning Ledger Entry v1
description: FR-LEARN: one hash-chained entry in kr.co.oruda.onsure.learning.OfficialLearningLedger's append-only sequence (LEARNING_CANDIDATE -> VALIDATION_REQUEST -> VALIDATION_PACK -> VALIDATION_RECEIPT -> PROMOTION -> APPLIED_LOCK). No learning or scheduled-validation result is recognized complete merely because a file, PASS result, or artifact exists -- only a full hash-bound chain through APPLIED_LOCK counts, and entry_hash covers every other field so a single mutated byte anywhere in the entry is detectable.
